card.name: Linking words in disease-risk statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and percent signs right after a risk, disease or birth-defect term, where a further condition or outcome comes next. Seen in genetics, pregnancy and childhood-disease text.

modes.label: Lists of conditions
modes.description: A comma or 'and' inside a list of diseases or birth defects.
modes.example: Examples of multifactorial disorders include heart disease, diabetes<<,>> spina bifida, anenceph

modes.label: Risk phrasing
modes.description: 'of', 'from' or 'and' right after the word risk or protected, before the named outcome.
modes.example: had an increased risk<< of>> one type of leukaemia.

modes.label: Rates in study results
modes.description: A percent sign after a frequency figure for a genetic or outcome group.

card.writes: Little clear effect. It slightly suppresses age words and promotes title-like words such as president.
card.plain: It marks the small joining words in sentences about the risk of diseases or birth defects, just before the next condition is named.
